subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 60 is on the climbable wall reachable by playing the Scarecrow Song and Hookshotting up.

evidence.quote:
Play the Scarecrow Song and a scarecrow 
will appear on the platform above you, use the Hookshot to get up there with 
him.  From here fire the Hookshot to get across to the other side onto the 
platform which rises up.  At the top you'll be in a room with a wall you can 
climb, at the top there you will come across GOLD SKULLTULA [60] on the wall, 
get it with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 061 is located on the wall immediately to the left in the room above the climbable wall.

evidence.quote:
Now climb up that wall and into the next room.  
Immediately take a look on your left here and you will find another GOLD 
SKULLTULA [061] just relaxing on the wall there.

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Stepping on the button and Hookshotting to the pillar at the top of the steep slope allows reaching a small chest containing a Huge Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Step on the button and then run to the bottom of the slope, whip out 
the Hookshot and fire it at the pillar at the top of the slope, this will pull 
you up and give you time to reach the small chest which happens to contain a 
HUGE RUPEE.

subject: Small Key
text: Bombing the crack on the platform leads to a Goron cage containing a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Place a bomb on the crack and drop down to the hall below 
which leads you to another Goron cage, step on the button to open it and then 
speak to the Goron.  Open the small chest to get a SMALL KEY and then climb up 
the chain link wall where you dropped down a moment ago.

subject: Small Key
text: Navigating across the pillars above leads to another Goron cage containing a small chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
From there just make your way across from one to the 
next until you reach the cage of the Goron, speak with him and then open the 
small chest to acquire another SMALL KEY.

subject: Compass
text: Following the right wall of the pillar maze room leads to a door with a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Stay along the right wall unless there is fire in your way, 
on this wall you will reach a door, go through it and open the large chest to 
acquire the COMPASS for the dungeon.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Pull the core of the Flare Dancer out with the Hookshot when it jumps out, slash it, and strike it with a charged Spin Attack as it flees.

evidence.quote:
When the Flare Dancer actually jumps out of the middle that is your chance.  Make 
sure you have the Hookshot equipped and target the Flare Dancing using the L/Z 
button.  Hit the Hookshot button and you should be able to pull the actual, 
hit-able section of the boss out.  Now it is entirely harmless and you are 
free to begin slashing away....As it runs around charge 
up the maximum power Spin Attack and move toward the boss, the instant it 
freaks out to turn around, let loose for good damage.  Do this about three or 
four times and the miniboss will quickly fall victim to your blade.

subject: Megaton Hammer
text: Following the thin path after stepping on the button leads to a large chest containing the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
Step on the button and run along the thin path that leads around to the 
large treasure chest at the top, you have more than enough time, it's just a 
matter of being careful not to fall that makes it difficult.  When you reach 
this large chest, open it up to get the MEGATON HAMMER.

subject: Megaton Hammer
text: Pounding the block between the torches with the Megaton Hammer transforms the floor into a staircase so a box can be placed on the switch.

evidence.quote:
After doing that, equip your Megaton 
Hammer and pound the block in the centre of that lowered area, the one right 
between the torches.  When this is done, the whole ground should transform 
into a staircase.  Pick up one of the two small boxes and jump down to the 
bottom.  Step on the button and then set down the box on top of it.

subject: Small Key
text: Playing the Song of Time moves the block to allow pounding a rusted button, freeing a Goron with a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the edge here and equip your Ocarina, you need to play the Song of 
Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) to move the block across from you.  Jump 
across and grab the edge, then pound the rusted button down with the hammer to 
open the cage below you.  Speak with the Goron and then get the SMALL KEY from 
the tiny treasure chest behind him.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 062 is crawling on the wall in the room with flying floor tiles and a huge blob.

evidence.quote:
In the room past this 
one, hold the R button to bring up your shield again and protect yourself from 
the floor tiles, then eliminate the huge blob from a distance.  There is a 
GOLD SKULLTULA [062] crawling around on the wall in here for you to kill

subject: Bombs
text: Defeating the second Flare Dancer causes a small chest containing Bombs to appear.

evidence.quote:
after that just head through the door here to encounter yet another Flare 
Dancer....After defeating the enemy a small chest appears 
containing BOMBS, what a nice treat.

subject: Boss Key
text: Pounding the rusted button down with the Megaton Hammer frees a Goron whose cell contains the Boss Key chest.

evidence.quote:
Head through the door and pound the 
button down using the Megaton Hammer.  Speak to the Goron and then open the 
chest behind him to acquire the BOSS KEY.

subject: Volvagia
text: The Megaton Hammer is used to strike the boss twice after it emerges from one of nine holes indicated by gathering flames.

evidence.quote:
Forget 
absolutely every weapon and item for this battle with the one exception being 
the Megaton Hammer, it's your only weapon.  There are nine holes in the field 
here and the boss will randomly pop out of one of them.  You can tell which 
one he is going to pop out of by seeing where the flames after gathering.  
When the boss pops out, keep your distance a bit, he will sweep around the 
proximity with some kind of flaming dragon hair.  After that you have a window 
to run up and slam him with the Megaton Hammer.  Doing so will make him swing 
his flaming hair one more time and then drop, allowing you to go in with the 
hammer for a second hit.

subject: Volvagia
text: Dodge the boss's flying fire attack by running continuously, and avoid large shadows on the ground when rocks fall from above.

evidence.quote:
He will use one of two attacks, either he will fly 
around the field breathing fire at you or he will drop rocks from above.  The 
fire one can be dodged simply by running and not stopping, being careful never 
to stay in his line of vision.  The rock one is even easier, they make large 
shadows before they fall so stay away from the shadows.

subject: Heart Container
text: A Heart Container appears where the boss's skull disappears.

evidence.quote: Grab the HEART CONTAINER which appears where the skull disappears and then

subject: Fire Medallion
text: Stepping into the warp portal triggers a scene where Link acquires the Fire Medallion.

evidence.quote: step into the warp portal for a scene where you acquire the FIRE MEDALLION.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 063 appears at night on the southwest wall reachable by riding the Magic Bean platform up and jumping off.

evidence.quote:
When you get into Zora's River, make your way up the path until your come to 
the Magic Bean platform.  Step on this platform and allow it to take you up to 
that area, high above the others with the hole in the ground and where there 
was a Cucco wandering around previously, at the top of that long ladder.  The 
Magic Bean platform doesn't actually stop there so you are going to have to 
jump off as you pass by.  Once you land, take a look to the southwest, if you 
don't see anything crawling on the wall then play the Sun's Song so that it 
changes to night, the GOLD SKULLTULA [063] will only appear on the wall during 
the night.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 064 can be grabbed with the Hookshot at night by standing on the fence of the bridge near the end of the river.

evidence.quote:
Make your way along toward the end of the river, and when you reach the bridge 
which takes you across, just before those funny land bridges, stand on the 
normal bridge and look to the north.  Look up at the top of the wall during 
the night and there you should see the Skulltula.  You cannot reach it with 
your Hookshot normally, what you have to do is hop up onto the fence below it, 
and use you Hookshot from there.  This way you will be able to reach the GOLD 
SKULLTULA [064].

subject: waterfall
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the waterfall opens the entrance leading into Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
From here make your way up across the land bridges and stand 
in front of the waterfall, play Zelda's Lullaby to open it up and go through.

Zora's Domain it seems is completely covered in ice

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Jumping across the spinning ice platforms heading east over the water leads to Piece of Heart 024.

evidence.quote:
Instead of seeing 
Jabu Jabu here you will find a slab of ice which runs up and out over the 
water.  Run along this ice and jump down to the ice platforms floating in the 
water.  The ones which lead east take you in the direction of a Piece of 
Heart, however it isn't meant to be easy....jump to one of the spinning platforms and just stay on it until it goes 
around, and then jump to get the PIECE OF HEART [024].
